nodes.long_description:
Predator Panic is a VR heist with no buttons for walking. You move like a monkey: push off the ground, swing your arms and climb trees with your own hands.

STEAL THE EGGS
Sneak into nests guarded by real-size dinosaurs and grab as many eggs as you dare. Every egg makes your bag heavier and slower. Get caught and your eggs spill on the ground.

FOUR HUNTERS, FOUR WAYS TO SURVIVE
- The Hatchery: raptors sleep on their nests. One loud slap and they wake up.
- The Dried River: a Metriacanthosaurus that hunts alone and rams the tree you're hiding in.
- The Volcano: a T-Rex that only sees what moves. Freeze, or hide in the caves.
- The Paddock: the Spectrex camouflages itself. Listen for it, or spot it with thermal goggles.
The longer you stay, the darker it gets and the sharper they hunt.

GEAR UP
Sell eggs at the station's incubator for coins. Spend them on stun grenades, tranquilizer darts, flares, smoke bombs, bigger backpacks and thermal goggles, plus around 20 cosmetics, from leaf crowns to a T-Rex head helmet.

PLAY TOGETHER
Join a room with a code or go public. Ride the party elevators down in a team of up to 6. The dinosaurs get tougher with every extra player, and every egg is shared with the whole team. Proximity voice chat lets you whisper plans, or scream.

Or just climb the giant trees of the free-play jungle and try to stay away from the raptors.

Online play needs an internet connection. Mute, block and report tools are built in.
nodes.short_description: You're a monkey. They're dinosaurs. Swing, climb and sprint with your own arms through jungle, volcano and ruined paddock to steal dinosaur eggs from right under their noses, then get out before you're caught. Play alone, or team up with friends online and hear each other with proximity voice chat. Sell your eggs, deck out your monkey and gear up for the next heist.

nodes.change_log:
Update 0.13.0: BELOW ZERO, part 1: The Way Down

THE MINE LIFT

Something is hidden under Station Zero. Go through the new tunnel in the Expeditions hall to find the old mine room and a giant chained lift.
To open it, find the 6 hidden clues, one in each old level. They glow a faint blue. Grab one to take it. You keep it even if you get caught!
In a party, only the leader needs all 6 clues.
NEW LEVEL: B1, THE BURIED LAB

An old lab, deep underground and dark. Something is still living down there.
Meet the Troodons: small, smart hunters that can open doors and crawl through the vents. Hide, listen, and slam doors in their faces!
Everyone gets a free helmet lamp. Tap your head to switch it on or off. In the dark they can't see you very well... unless you have a light.
No eggs and no coins down here. It's all about the story and getting out alive.
3 new quests: LIGHTS OUT, SLAM! and VENT RAT.
THE STORY

Find notes, old tapes and computers to learn what really happened at Station Zero.
Notes are real paper: pick them up and they turn to face you so you can read them. Twist your wrist to read the back. Let go and they float to the floor.
Put a tape in an old tape player to play it. The mine room keeps a copy of every tape you find.
Everything you find goes in the Field Journal, a real book on the mine room's desk. Grab a page anywhere and swipe it over to turn it, or pull a coloured ribbon to jump to a part.
The journal has a pencil sketch of every dinosaur in the game.
Secret codes: watch our Discord for codes, then type them on the lobby computer's new CODES key for bonus pages.
ALSO NEW

In every dinosaur level you now hear your heartbeat (and feel it in your controllers) when a hunter is close. The closer it gets, the faster it beats.
The lobby mirrors no longer look grey on the headset.

Update 0.12.0: Fan Art Gallery and catch shows!

NEW: FAN ART GALLERY

A brand new room in the lobby! Go through the Expeditions hall and look for the gold doorway between the party elevators.
Draw a dinosaur, a monkey or anything from the game and post it in our Discord. Your art could end up on the wall, with your name under it!
Press the DISCORD button by the sign to open our Discord. Ask a grown-up first: Discord is 13+.
SEE YOUR FRIENDS GET CAUGHT

When a dinosaur catches a friend, you now see it happen, and every hunter has its own way of carrying them off.
Raptors drag them into the bushes, the T-Rex tosses them into the air, the Tylosaurus pulls them down into the deep, and the Spectrex... you can't see the Spectrex at all.
FOSSIL DIG

The Spinosaurus is MUCH faster now. Only a buggy can outrun it!
Bigger buggies and a bigger dig truck. They still turn just as tight.
The camp is sorted into four areas with big signs: Garage, Workshop, Hall of Fame and Campfire.
Honk the horn with B while you drive. It scares the lizards away!
Hear your friend's scream when they're caught, and watch the Spinosaurus burst out of the sand and drag them under.
Split up far apart and each group gets its own Spinosaurus, up to 3 at once!

Update 0.11.0: Fossil Dig!

NEW MINI GAME: FOSSIL DIG

Walk through the new door in the Mini Games room into an endless desert. Dig alone or with up to 5 friends.
Jump in a dune buggy or the big dig truck and steer with your own hands on the wheel.
Sweep the Bone Scanner around: it beeps faster the closer you get. Then dig with a real shovel and carry the lump of rock back to camp.
Chip the rock off with a hammer, brush off the dust and wash off the mud. Only then does the value scanner tell you what you found and what it's worth.
Everyone on the dig gets the full price in coins!
46 kinds of find: ammonites, raptor claws, T-Rex skulls, geodes, bugs in amber... and some junk. Does that old flip phone still ring?
BEWARE THE SPINOSAURUS

Every so often a 15 metre Spinosaurus hunts through the desert. Its sail cuts through the sand like a shark fin, circling closer and closer... then it bursts out!
Listen for the roar and feel the ground shake. Run back to camp, or jump in a buggy and outrun it.
MYTHIC FINDS

Mythics are super rare: about 1 in 2,500. Dig far from camp for better luck.
Find one and the lights go out... then the sky turns rainbow with fireworks for everyone!
MORE AT CAMP

Your own museum: every kind you find goes on its shelves for good.
Build three dinosaur skeletons bone by bone: Triceratops, T-Rex and Spinosaurus. Finish one for up to 40,000 coins and watch it come alive!
Upgrade your shovel, scanner, engine, cargo rack and headlights.
The wanted board: one kind of find pays double on every dig.
Catch the golden tumbleweed for free coins.
Sandstorms blow in and bury everything, leaving fresh finds all over the desert.
Roast marshmallows at the campfire, listen to the radio and pat the sleepy camel.
WORLDWIDE LEADERBOARDS

Three new boards at camp: most valuable find, most coins from digging and most Mythics found.

Update 0.10.1

Videos you record on your headset now have your friends' voices in them, not just yours. Voice chat now plays through the game's own sound, so the headset's recorder picks it up.
Voices still come from where your friends are standing, and fade as they get further away.

Update 0.10.0: The Frozen Peak!

LEVEL 6: THE FROZEN PEAK

A brand-new level: a snowy mountain at sunset, with a frozen lake in the middle and pine trees everywhere.
The hunter is the Yutyrannus: a 9 metre feathered tyrant with a shaggy white coat, icy-blue tips and a deep, booming roar.
It follows your footprints and handprints in the snow. Climb on rocks and trees to leave no trail, or wait: tracks fade after a minute.
Blizzards blow in every 90 seconds. You can hardly see, and neither can it, so your tracks are all it has. Then the wind wipes them away.
Up a pine tree? It slams the trunk. Snow dumps on you and the branches ice over, so only gripping hands hold on!
Squeeze into a narrow rock crack to hide. It snaps, claws and sniffs at the gap, but it can't get in.
The frozen lake is a shortcut, but the ice is thin. One egg makes it creak. Two eggs and you fall through! Climb out within 10 seconds or you freeze.
Two nests: one under a rock overhang and one on a high ledge. Yutyrannus eggs are huge (each one takes two places in your bag) and sell for 2,000 coins.
Finish the Ocean's quests, then unlock Level 6 for 40,000 coins.
NEW QUESTS

The Ocean now has quests: Deep Diver, Big Catch and Island Hopper.
The Frozen Peak has three more: Cold Haul, Blizzard Thief and Thin Ice.
DINO HUNT

Gun balance: the free Dart Pistol hits a lot harder, and the Nail Blaster and Boom Stick a little harder. The Railgun, Rocket Launcher, Minigun and Flamethrower hit less hard.
The raptor has less health. The Spectrex has a little more.
FIXES

Dinosaurs' legs no longer fly up in the air when they walk into a tree.
A heavy backpack no longer plays the "egg going in" sound with every step. Now the eggs bump softly together while you run (and the dinosaurs can hear it!).
